description: Réseau routier dans la deuxième moitié du XVIII° siècle (carte des Chasses) d'Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. Ce jeu de données représente le réseau routier d'Île-de-France vers 1700. Croisée avec d'autres jeux de données du SIGR (limites communales, couvert forestier...), cette donnée schématique permet d'approcher et de quantifier l'évolution des territoires analysés et d'avoir une idée globale du développement des infrastructures. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Routes, Urbanisme, Transport. The portal shows 708 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
